'''Red Seven''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|callsign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who flew in [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] during the [[Recapture of Tythe]]. Red Seven [[Death/Legends|died]] during the battle after their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] lost both its wings, causing it to veer off into [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Labyrinth" />
